Summary
: These Sutras give some general information about the performance of sacrifices, and may prove useful to the students both of the Shrauta and the Grihya sacrifices. Paribhasha is defined as a general rule or definition applicable throughout a whole system, and more binding than any particular rule.
Alternative titles: Āpastamba-yajña-paribhāṣā-sūtras (आपस्तम्ब-यज्ञ-परिभाषा-सूत्रस्), Paribhāṣāsūtra (परिभाषासूत्र), Yajñaparibhāṣāsūtra (यज्ञपरिभाषासूत्र), Paribhasha, Paribhaṣasutra, Yajnaparibhasasutra, Yajnaparibhashasutra.
